_doc: Lote 2: resto de piezas con malla en RealMeshNames(). Size = tabla de JamBuildPart.cpp.

parts.name: SM_PART_CYLINDER
parts.detail: a short thick wooden log tube made of wooden staves lying horizontally, exactly three times as long as it is thick (like a big rolling pin, not slender), two dark iron bands near both ends, flat round end caps. Side view at a slight three-quarter angle

parts.name: SM_PART_WALL
parts.detail: a sturdy free-standing wooden wall section made of thick vertical planks held by two horizontal dark iron straps with big bolts, wider than tall and fairly thick. Front three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_PART_PANEL
parts.detail: a thin flat square wooden panel made of planks with a dark iron frame around the edges and bolts in the corners, standing upright. Front three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_PART_GIRDER
parts.detail: a very long riveted iron girder beam lying horizontally, square cross-section with lattice holes, about fifteen times longer than it is thick. Side three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_PART_BALL
parts.detail: a heavy round wooden ball wrapped with two crossing dark iron bands with rivets, a perfect sphere

parts.name: SM_DEV_SLED
parts.detail: a low wooden sled: a flat plank deck on top of two long curved wooden runner skis with iron edges, long and low, more than twice as long as wide. Three-quarter view from above

parts.name: SM_JOINT_HINGE
parts.detail: a chunky dark iron hinge joint: a horizontal metal barrel pin three times longer than thick with two small hinge leaves and big bolts. Three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_JOINT_TURNTABLE
parts.detail: a round rotating turntable: a wooden disc on top of a dark iron geared base, short and wide like a drum

parts.name: SM_ANCHOR_STAKE
parts.detail: a short wooden ground anchor stake standing upright with a pointed iron tip at the bottom and an iron ring on top

parts.name: SM_DEV_SPRING
parts.detail: a big coiled steel spring squeezed between two round wooden plates, short and wide, standing upright

parts.name: SM_DEV_JET
parts.detail: a handmade jet engine lying horizontally: round metal intake ring at the front, riveted copper and iron body, dark exhaust nozzle at the back, one and a half times longer than wide. Side three-quarter view

parts.name: SM_DEV_TURBINE
parts.detail: a large ducted turbine seen from the front at a slight angle: many wooden blades around an iron hub inside a thick round riveted iron casing, shallow depth like a thick disc

parts.name: SM_DEV_HOVER
parts.detail: a floating levitation stone: a rough grey rock with glowing purple crystal veins held in a small dark iron cage

parts.name: SM_DEV_WING
parts.detail: a single flat glider wing made of cream canvas stretched over a thin wooden frame, very thin and twice as wide as deep, seen from above at a three-quarter angle

parts.name: SM_DEV_SAIL
parts.detail: a square cream canvas sail stretched on a thin wooden frame with ropes at the corners, flat and upright, facing the viewer at a three-quarter angle

parts.name: SM_DEV_STABILIZER
parts.detail: a small gyroscope stabilizer device: brass rings around a spinning core on a short round wooden base

parts.name: SM_CTRL_HEAD
parts.detail: a boxy robot pilot head: a riveted metal helmet cube with two big round glowing yellow eye lenses on the front and a small antenna on top

parts.name: SM_PWR_BATTERY_L
parts.detail: a large chunky cube battery with a dark iron frame, copper coils on the sides, a big painted yellow lightning bolt on the front and two big terminals on top (red and black)

parts.name: SM_DEV_FROST
parts.detail: a handmade frost cannon lying horizontally: a pale cyan ice crystal tank with frosty pipes and a short iron nozzle pointing forward

parts.name: SM_DEV_BEAM
parts.detail: a handmade beam emitter lying horizontally: a slim iron tube with a large glowing magenta crystal lens at the front tip and a wooden clamp bracket, four times longer than thick

parts.name: SM_DEV_SHOCK
parts.detail: a handmade tesla coil gun lying horizontally: a copper coil wrapped tube with a metal sphere at the front tip on a small wooden base

parts.name: SM_CTRL_TIMEBOMB
parts.detail: a round cartoon bomb: black iron sphere with a rope-wrapped band, a short fuse on top and a small brass clock dial

parts.name: SM_DEV_HYDRANT
parts.detail: a handmade water cannon lying horizontally: a blue water tank with a brass valve wheel and a short brass nozzle pointing forward

parts.name: SM_DEV_LIGHT
parts.detail: a handmade searchlight lamp: a round brass lamp housing with a big glass lens facing forward on a small iron bracket
